title: Chapter 248 Go Back To My Own Home
content:
Chapter 248 Go Back To My Own Home

Go together!

As soon as these words were spoken, none of the disciples of the Alchemy Peak present were willing to stay and all expressed their willingness to go.

And this result was not surprising at all.

"Then let me go."

In this way, the entire alchemy peak was empty.

As for the alchemy meeting, it was basically nothing.

The students of the academy looked at the departing disciples of Liandan Peak in a confused look, with several big question marks on their heads.

What's going on?

It would be fine if all the alchemists failed at the alchemy meeting, but why did the alchemist end in just half a month?

It's so fucking there's a show.

After inquiring, everyone learned that the disciples of the Alchemy Peak were going to the Wood Fairy World to watch Teacher Qiao’s alchemy competition.

Everyone was immediately envious.

Teacher Qiao’s student treatment is good.

At the same time, Bai Lushuang also brought the disciples of the Alchemy Peak to the outside of the Alchemy Club.

"Teacher Tan."

When Bai Lushuang saw Tan Songci, he hurriedly bowed.

The other disciples also bowed one after another.

In response to this, Tan Songci smiled and nodded, "Everything is ready."

"It's ready."

Upon hearing this, Tan Songci looked at the people behind him.

Those were his students. They were also very interested when they heard that they were going to the Muxian Realm to watch Teacher Qiao’s alchemy competition.

So Tan Songci also brought them with him.

Around them, some passing students watched this scene and were envious.

It’s good to have a tutor.

Some other students with tutors sighed slightly.

I have a tutor, but the tutor is unwilling to go, and I can't do anything if I want to go.

As for being shameless and asking Instructor Tan to take him with him, they didn't dare to do so at all.

If my mentor knows this, then I won’t beat my butt into eight pieces.

In fact, Tan Songci also asked about the other tutors in the academy.

But without exception, either you don’t have time or you don’t have interest.

At this time, Tan Songci took out a small bookstore. With the light flashing, Bai Lushuang and others and his students disappeared from the spot, turned into a stream of light, and entered the bookstore.

Space-based treasures.

Even in the Tiandi Academy, it is an extremely precious treasure.

After putting away the bookstore, Tan Songci no longer hesitated, and directly broke through the space, stepped out and disappeared into the academy.

......

Zhuyun Peak.

Xiao Yin slowly walked out of the hall and felt the empty Zhuyun Peak. Xiao Yin shook his head slightly.

All left.

All are gone.

Standing there, Xiao Yin looked into the sky.

That direction is exactly the direction of the Xiao clan.

Since the Xiao clan has undergone earth-shaking changes in the entire Xiao clan.

The Xiao clan also leaped through a leap and became one of the best super forces in the entire fairyland.

Almost every person from the Xiao clan can look at people with his nostrils when he goes out.

Dare to touch me?

Try me and try it. Twelve peak powerhouses in the Immortal Emperor Realm, I’ll ask if you are afraid?

As for the other three ancient families.

The Xie tribe has completely cut off external contacts, and the outside world can basically no longer see the Xie tribe.

The Chu clan was basically not much different, and he was beaten so hard that he almost didn't dare to go out.

Because the Ye clan is much stronger than the Xie and Chu clans, the losses are minimal, but there are some casualties, and the protection formation is broken.

Among the four ancient families, there are some terrifying old monsters.

So it is basically impossible to destroy the clan.

Of course, the former Xiao clan was an exception.

Standing there for a long time, Xiao Yin finally turned around.

Although the strength of the top-level Xiao clan is extremely terrifying, the strength of the middle and lower-level clans is far inferior to the other three clans.

Now, the Xiao clan naturally seizes the opportunity to make up for this shortcoming as soon as possible.

Since Xiao Yin became the instructor of the inner courtyard of Tiandi Academy, the Xiao clan has also begun to vigorously cultivate the younger generation of the clan, and many young Xiao clan members have been sent to the innocence of Tiandi Academy.

I will only be able to enter the inner courtyard one day.

At that time, with Xiao Yin's help, he will inevitably grow rapidly, which is one of the reasons why Xiao Yin returned to the academy.

However, whether they can enter the inner courtyard depends on their own abilities.

After a moment of silence, Xiao Yin moved and left the academy.

And when she appeared again, a magnificent list of magnificent Tian appeared in front of her.

Around them, countless terrifying auras of the Dao continue to linger, and the power of the law spreads across the list.

Looking at the list in front of him, Xiao Yin looked moved and slowly looked up.

I saw three gold-plated characters engraved at the top of the list - the Immortal Emperor List!

.........

Wood Fairy World.

In the deserted city, in the past two days, the deserted city suddenly became extremely lively.

Before, only practitioners from all over the Wood Immortal Realm came to the deserted city.

But now, not only the practitioners from the Wood Immortal Realm, but also the practitioners from the Immortal Realm and even the rest of the Immortal Realm have appeared in the Wilderness City.

Everyone's purpose is self-evident.

Jordan Yang.

That is the leader of the alchemy world in the fairyland.

Now, I came to such a place to compete with the alchemist here.

Although at first everyone found it a little unbelievable.

But when they arrived at the deserted city, everything suddenly became reasonable again.

The deserted city is so terrifying!

There is such a terrifying force hidden in this Wood Immortal Realm. Even if you look at the Immortal Realm, this wasteland city is definitely the best in their eyes.

On the first day, people only felt that the deserted city was rich and noble.

But until the moment a powerful man in the ninth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm caused trouble and was instantly suppressed, the world understood.

This deserted city is really powerful.

In this case, this alchemy competition will be interesting.

Being in such a terrifying force, the alchemist would probably not be that bad.

This trip was not in vain.

And at this moment, a familiar dragon roar suddenly sounded from the void.

When everyone heard the sound, they immediately saw a huge ice dragon with a cold body that was emerging from the void and was rushing towards the city.

Huge dragon shadows cover the sky and the sun!

"That's, the six-clawed true dragon!"

Everyone in the city was shocked, while the locals in the wasteland city smiled faintly.

The moment they saw Ao Qing, they realized something.

The lady is back.

"Huh? Wait, this dragon won't want to airborne into the city."

"Airborne? What a joke? The law of forbidden air in this city is so powerful that even the strong people in the Immortal Emperor Realm dare not fly. Where did this dragon get the courage?"

"Haha, I've watched a good show. I guess where did the big power pride of heaven want to show off."

Seeing the dragon trying to enter the city directly from the void, everyone looked gloating.

At the beginning, many powerful cultivators wanted to go directly into the air, but either were slashed down by an astonishing sword energy or were bombarded into pieces by the law of forbidden air.

Without exception.

Now, haha, maybe there will be dragon meat to eat later.

In the void.

"Uh, Sister Lu, are we too high-profile?"

Ao Qing sat next to Lu Xue and the others on his head. Qin Feng looked at the deserted city below, shocked in his heart, and quickly spoke.

Such a giant city must not be an ordinary force. If you enter like this, you really don’t take it seriously.

It's easy to make enemies.

Obviously, although Qin Feng is careless on weekdays, he is still very cautious at critical moments.

Hearing Qin Feng's words, Xiao Luo sat aside and smiled without saying a word.

Lu Xue said directly: "High-profile?"

"I go home and do whatever I want."
